handoff_instructions.required_question: Which chat and role from this handoff would you like me to continue as?
usage: Use project_level as shared project context and chats as role-specific continuity context.
Do not merge unresolved proposals into confirmed architecture.
Treat repository_snapshot as historical inventory captured at generation time; verify current GitHub state when repository truth matters.
If a requested chat or fact is not represented here, say so rather than inventing history.

project_level.project_summary: A Godot 4 procedural voxel terrain engine that began as an editor-oriented sampled point-field visualizer and evolved into a modular offline generation and runtime streaming architecture. PointFieldResource is the authoritative regular-lattice scalar-field representation; visualization and meshers are consumers. Surface Nets is implemented as an algorithm consumer, ArrayMesh output exists, chunk assets and manifests provide the persisted terrain boundary, and ChunkStreamer handles runtime loading and target-relative residency of precomputed terrain. The project also has deterministic headless validation, dedicated validation scenes, GitHub Pages Integration Preview browser/mobile QA, shared mobile controls, version/release workflows, ADRs, performance evidence conventions, and a mutable ROADMAP.md. The long-term target is large precomputed terrain such as a several-kilometer asteroid, with generation and meshing remaining offline while runtime becomes primarily an asset-loading, residency, and eventual LOD problem. A dedicated Project Engineering Steward now maintains this mutable handoff JSON as an engineering-memory and continuity layer over authoritative repository, ADR, roadmap, test, and validation sources.
key_steps: Built PointFieldVisualizer for regular 3D sample lattices, density visualization, FastNoiseLite-driven generation, resource save/load, and editor regeneration.
Moved geometry, positions, densities, indexing, sampling, validation, serialization state, cell helpers, and generation responsibility into PointFieldResource.
Hardened PointFieldResource as the single source of scalar-field truth and kept consumers from duplicating field state.
Implemented SurfaceNetsMesher and validated field freshness, indexing, winding, and orientation contracts.
Introduced chunk-domain types, precomputed chunk assets, manifests, and ChunkAssetBaker.
Implemented ChunkStreamer for precomputed runtime load/unload and target-relative residency.
Added chunk validation and chunk streaming validation scenes with headless coverage.
Added long-lived GitHub Pages Integration Preview categories while preserving immutable release demos.
Added shared MobileTouchControls for browser/mobile validation.
Added release/version validation, demo-manifest tooling, architecture/roadmap records, and performance reporting conventions.
Recorded the offline/runtime terrain boundary as an ADR and elevated resource loading ahead of LOD in ROADMAP.md.
Created docs/project-chat-handoff.json on the project-chat-handoff branch as a mutable project continuity artifact.
Defined the Project Engineering Steward role to reconcile project/chat memory against authoritative sources.
Froze and implemented the PEMS/COVE v1 engineering-memory representation through Phase 6, with RFC 8785 behavior accepted as the independent jcs/1 deterministic byte contract.
Accepted the deterministic one-way current-handoff importer as Phase 6 evidence while keeping all importer-generated semantic IDs provisional pending Steward admission.
Authorized and began Phase 7 longitudinal shadow validation while docs/project-chat-handoff.json remains canonical and Phase 8 canonical adoption remains separately gated.

Established complete-source repository-write safety for history-sensitive files: verified complete source state, one immutable source identity, optimistic concurrency, and post-write verification; placeholders and partial replacement payloads are prohibited.

ownership_rules: PointFieldResource is the authoritative sampled scalar-field representation and remains algorithm-independent.
PointFieldVisualizer and other visualization types are consumers, not field authorities.
SurfaceNetsMesher is a field-to-mesh consumer and must not own noise, streaming, scene-tree state, or field configuration.
TerrainChunkAsset and TerrainChunkManifest describe persisted data and lookup metadata, not runtime generation policy.
ChunkStreamer owns runtime loading/residency and consumes precomputed assets rather than invoking field generation or Surface Nets.
Do not weaken engine contracts merely to optimize or make demos easier.

project_owner_expectations: Act as a senior engine programmer and co-designer, not merely as a code generator.
Consider architecture and long-term maintainability and explain significant design decisions and tradeoffs.
Identify unnecessary coupling, duplicated responsibilities, and unclear ownership.
Keep future Surface Nets, Dual Contouring, chunked terrain, and likely extensions in mind without over-engineering.
Favor reusable, well-defined APIs when justified; suggest refactors only when they materially improve the system.
Complete focused implementation/fix requests first unless an architectural problem would make the work incorrect or create significant technical debt.
Name Git branches after the feature being worked on, never generic names.
Every substantial engine feature requires a dedicated validation scene, relevant headless validation, and GitHub Pages Integration Preview exposure when browser-suitable.
Integration Preview categories are long-lived subsystem validation surfaces; extend existing categories in place when practical.
For runtime streaming features, update preview/integration/streaming/ rather than proliferating feature-specific categories.
Planning and architecture documents should describe decisions, constraints, and outcomes without prescribing implementation to competent professionals.
Project continuity information is mutable and should be reconciled rather than treated as append-only history.
A receiving chat given this handoff must ask which recorded chat and role to continue as before beginning project work.

engineering_memory.mutation_policy: Rebuild and replace the canonical JSON when reconciling; preserve meaningful history but update stale current-state claims.

representation_workstream.phase6_importer: Deterministic one-way conversion from docs/project-chat-handoff.json to normalized PEMS; generated semantic IDs remain provisional until Steward admission.
representation_workstream.phase7_scope: Longitudinal noncanonical shadow validation across real Steward reconciliations, including deterministic regeneration, identity/admission behavior, provenance evolution, human reconstruction, and size evidence.

repository_write_safety.rule: History-sensitive writes require complete verified source state, one consistent immutable source identity, exact preservation where append-only history applies, optimistic concurrency, and post-write verification. Truncated, placeholder, inferred, or partial replacement payloads are prohibited.

chats.title: Procedural Terrain Architecture
chats.role: Senior engine architect / engineering mentor reviewing architecture, roadmap, planning quality, and agent work.
chats.summary: Reviewed prior chat work as a mentor, assessed engineering behavior, created improvement guidance, repeatedly analyzed updated main, established ADR/roadmap recording, and reviewed planning proposals including resource-loading analysis. This became the primary architecture-governance thread.
chats.relationship_with_project_owner: The owner expects architecture-aware mentorship, practical recommendations, firm but constructive review, and architecture/roadmap documents useful to humans and agents without prescribing implementation to competent professionals.
key_decisions_or_outcomes: Record architecture decisions and roadmap adjustments derived from updated main.
Keep ROADMAP.md mutable.
Planning artifacts should define context, constraints, decisions, and desired outcomes rather than implementation recipes.
Resource loading was elevated ahead of LOD.

chats.title: Godot Voxel Terrain Progress
chats.role: Senior Godot 4 engine programmer validating milestone completion and deployment status.
chats.summary: Tracked the completed foundational generation and first runtime streaming architecture, especially chunk residency PR #43 and its validation/demo requirements, and confirmed CI/publication state when requested.
chats.relationship_with_project_owner: The owner expects repository state, CI, and published demo claims to be verified rather than assumed.
key_decisions_or_outcomes: Runtime residency is target-relative and manifest-driven.
Streaming validation uses the existing /streaming/ Integration Preview.

chats.title: Chunk Residency Implementation
chats.role: Senior Godot 4 engine programmer implementing target-relative chunk residency and validation.
chats.summary: Extended ChunkStreamer from individual load/unload operations into deterministic target-relative residency. Incomplete validation coverage and web exposure were corrected, reinforcing the project's feature-completion standard.
chats.relationship_with_project_owner: The owner is strict that validation exercise real runtime paths, fail clearly, and update the existing streaming Integration Preview in place.
key_decisions_or_outcomes: Substantial runtime features require dedicated validation scenes.
Browser-suitable validation requires GitHub Pages exposure.
Streaming features update the existing streaming preview.
Use realistic production-path terrain data when practical.

chats.title: API Assessment Review
chats.role: Senior Godot 4 engine programmer preparing nf/integration for merge and hardening browser validation.
chats.summary: Reviewed demos, added streaming validation to the web deployment path, fixed missing demo data, switched validation to noise-generated terrain, and prepared integration after architecture/tests/browser QA were satisfactory.
chats.relationship_with_project_owner: The owner expects integration work to be green, browser-testable, architecture-correct, and versioned consistently before merge.
key_decisions_or_outcomes: Streaming demo must be exported and present in the shared selector.
Validation should use real production-path terrain data when practical.
Version/check requirements are part of PR readiness.

chats.title: API Review and Refinement
chats.role: Senior Godot 4 engine programmer auditing and finishing PointFieldResource API contracts.
chats.summary: Focused on field freshness, authoritative indexing, bulk density installation, consumer correctness, documentation conventions, and avoiding unnecessary wrappers or broad refactors.
chats.relationship_with_project_owner: The owner expects a stable algorithm-independent field contract, small justified API changes, and no redesign merely for elegance.
key_decisions_or_outcomes: PointFieldResource remains the algorithm-independent scalar-field authority.
Cell indexing belongs on PointFieldResource.
Consumers should require current field data.
Bulk density installation is preferable to exposing dirty-state manipulation.
Do not add redundant xyz wrappers when Vector3i APIs already express the contract.

chats.title: Add a player control UI for touch on mobile
chats.role: Senior Godot 4 gameplay/tooling programmer adding mobile browser controls for validation demos.
chats.summary: Added and iterated touch controls so browser/mobile demos can be navigated and validated, converging on one shared MobileTouchControls implementation.
chats.relationship_with_project_owner: The owner expects mobile controls to serve real human QA without duplicating production or demo logic unnecessarily.
key_decisions_or_outcomes: Use one shared touch-control implementation.
Keep Web-specific touch fallbacks isolated from native input behavior.

chats.title: Dual Contouring Explanation
chats.role: Computer science professor and videogame programmer specializing in voxel terrain and meshing systems.
chats.summary: Explained Dual Contouring from scalar-field sign changes through Hermite samples, gradients, tangent-plane constraints, QEF minimization, topology generation, and chunk-boundary concerns in the context of the existing architecture.
chats.relationship_with_project_owner: The owner wanted a conceptual and implementation-oriented explanation detailed enough to develop Dual Contouring later while avoiding premature abstractions.
key_decisions_or_outcomes: Dual Contouring should be a separate mesher consuming PointFieldResource.
A future QEF solver should be a math utility without terrain-engine ownership.
Shared abstractions should emerge from concrete duplication.
Keep sample-space and cell-space coordinate domains explicit.

chats.title: Chunking System Design
chats.role: Senior engine architect co-designing chunked terrain generation and runtime boundaries.
chats.summary: Designed the transition from a single field/mesh into deterministic Vector3i-addressed generation chunks, persisted assets/manifests, and runtime streaming, establishing the offline/runtime split later implemented.
chats.relationship_with_project_owner: The owner expects chunking to scale the system without contaminating PointFieldResource or mesher responsibilities with streaming concerns.
key_decisions_or_outcomes: PointFieldResource remains chunk-local-capable without becoming streaming-aware.
Chunk identity uses deterministic Vector3i coordinates.
Boundary sample ownership must support seam-free neighbors.
Runtime streams precomputed assets rather than generating terrain.

chats.title: Surface Net Mesher Design
chats.role: Senior graphics/engine programmer designing and implementing Surface Nets.
chats.summary: Designed and implemented SurfaceNetsMesher consuming PointFieldResource, repaired checks and integration issues, and reviewed the implemented feature scope.
chats.relationship_with_project_owner: The owner expects the mesher to be readable, correct, stateless with respect to field ownership, and compatible with future Dual Contouring without generic-framework overreach.
key_decisions_or_outcomes: Surface Nets is a stateless consumer of PointFieldResource.
Version 0.2.0 was appropriate for the first major Surface Nets milestone under the then-current convention.
Feature branches remain feature-named.

chats.title: Voxel Terrain Generator GDScript
chats.role: Senior Godot 4 engine programmer evolving the initial editor voxel-field prototype into a clean resource/visualizer architecture.
chats.summary: Built the original point-field tooling and produced the first detailed split between PointFieldResource and PointFieldVisualizer, seeding the later architecture.
chats.relationship_with_project_owner: The owner expects practical Godot implementation plus architectural guidance, modular editor-friendly design, official GDScript style, public ## docs, stable class_name PointFieldVisualizer, and string-based deferred calls.
key_decisions_or_outcomes: PointFieldResource owns field geometry/data/indexing/sampling/generation state.
PointFieldVisualizer is visualization-only.
Use string names for deferred calls.
Keep class_name PointFieldVisualizer.
Split regeneration by responsibility.
Use feature-named branches.

chats.title: Workflows
chats.role: Senior CI/CD and Godot web-deployment engineer maintaining GitHub Actions and GitHub Pages demos.
chats.summary: Debugged workflow/export failures and helped establish immutable release demos plus a mutable Integration Preview with manifest/selector injection.
chats.relationship_with_project_owner: The owner expects deployment failures to be investigated to green, existing URLs preserved, and workflow changes understandable and maintainable.
key_decisions_or_outcomes: Preserve demo URLs and immutable release behavior.
Integration Preview is mutable current QA.
Shared selector injection and generated manifests are the standard publication path.

chats.title: New splash screen design
chats.role: Visual/product designer plus implementation partner for project branding.
chats.summary: Iterated the project splash toward a simpler title-centered design and integrated SVG source plus PNG runtime artwork.
chats.relationship_with_project_owner: The owner prefers restrained project identity and simple graphic hierarchy rather than decorative clutter.
key_decisions_or_outcomes: Keep the splash simple and project-focused.
Use SVG as source artwork and PNG as runtime artifact when appropriate.

chats.title: Connecting GitHub to Project
chats.role: Repository setup and project documentation assistant.
chats.summary: Helped connect the project to GitHub, draft repository descriptions, discuss connector access, and establish the repository as the shared implementation surface.
chats.relationship_with_project_owner: The owner expects the assistant to use the connected GitHub repository directly when appropriate and distinguish connector capability from generic web access.
key_decisions_or_outcomes: Connected GitHub access is the preferred path for repository state and changes.

chats.title: Project Engineering Steward / Handoff Memory
chats.role: Project Engineering Steward: Staff/Principal-level architecture steward and technical project historian responsible for engineering memory, continuity, and reconciliation.
chats.summary: Created the mutable project handoff JSON on the project-chat-handoff branch, defined the role responsible for maintaining it, established receiving-chat handoff behavior, and evolved the engineering-memory representation through the frozen PEMS/COVE v1 sequence. Phases 1 through 6 are accepted complete; Phase 7 longitudinal shadow validation is authorized and in progress while the existing JSON remains canonical. The Steward also established complete-source repository-write safety after append-only history failures exposed the danger of placeholder or partial replacement payloads.
chats.relationship_with_project_owner: The owner expects this role to preserve trustworthy engineering continuity, distinguish current truth from historical/proposed information, keep the JSON mutable, avoid inventing missing context, and use Git, ADRs, ROADMAP.md, tests, and validation scenes as authoritative sources for their respective domains. A receiving chat must select a recorded chat and role before resuming project work.
key_decisions_or_outcomes: The project handoff is a mutable continuity layer, not an authoritative replacement for Git, ADRs, ROADMAP.md, tests, or validation scenes.
The handoff lives on project-chat-handoff and routine reconciliation does not merge it to main.
A receiving chat must ask which recorded chat and role to continue as.
The Project Engineering Steward owns reconciliation and replaces the JSON with a freshly generated canonical snapshot.
Meaningful historical disagreement should be preserved while current authoritative state is clearly distinguished.
Steward reconciliation modifies only Steward-owned continuity artifacts, not production code or authoritative project documents.
PEMS/COVE v1 is the frozen engineering-memory representation contract; jcs/1 is the accepted deterministic byte contract and remains independently versioned.
The Phase 6 importer is accepted as deterministic one-way evidence; importer-generated semantic IDs remain provisional until Steward admission.
Phase 7 shadow artifacts are noncanonical evidence. docs/project-chat-handoff.json remains authoritative until a separate Phase 8 owner/Steward adoption decision.

History-sensitive repository writes require complete verified source state, one immutable source identity, optimistic concurrency, and post-write verification; placeholders and partial replacements are prohibited.
